name.value: Festival Lawn at Deer Lake Park

description.value: Deer Lake Park is an open-air concert venue in Burnaby managed by Live Nation, hosting a seasonal schedule of major outdoor shows on a large lawn setting. It is accessible via multiple transit routes and sits adjacent to the Shadbolt Centre for the Arts. Cyclists attending events will find limited bike racks near the East Gate entrance, though bikes are not permitted inside the venue grounds.

address.value: 6450 Deer Lake Ave., Burnaby, BC V5G 2J3
